evidence: Atomic force microscope images revealed that the deposited AI2O3 films were exceptionally flat with a surface roughness of only ± 3 (rms) after 500 AB cycles and the deposition of a film thickness of ~ 560 A. The real index of refraction of these AI2O3 films was also measured to be n= 1.65 ± 0.02 assuming that absorption is negligible (k=0). These spectra were consistent with amorphous AI2O3.
